notablePrerequisites: Wellwisher does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Tap Wellwisher to activate it, gaining at least 3 life.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning itself to your hand, untapping Wellwisher.
Pay 2 life to cast Wirewood Symbiote.
Defiler of Vigor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve Wirewood Symbiote.
Repeat.
